title: Kill /runs standalone route and clean up references
description:
Remove the standalone `/runs` route now that all run viewing is integrated into `/workflows`. This is the final cleanup task.

**Changes:**

**App.tsx:**
- Delete `const RunsPage = lazy(() => import("./pages/RunsPage"))` 
- Delete `<Route path="/runs" element={<RunsPage />} />`
- The `/runs/:id` route was never standalone (runs are at `/workflows/:id/runs/:runId`)

**AppShell.tsx:**
- Remove the nav item `{ path: "/runs", label: "Runs", icon: Activity }` from sidebar

**CommandPalette.tsx:**
- Update any entry returning `/runs` to point to `/workflows` instead

**RunsPage.tsx:**
- Delete `dashboard/src/pages/RunsPage.tsx` entirely — its content is replaced by ActiveRunsStrip + WorkflowDetailPage run history

**Grep sweep:** Search entire dashboard/src for remaining references to `/runs` as a standalone path (not `/workflows/:id/runs/:runId` which is valid). Fix or remove any found.

**Supersedes** task-e340773f from epic-06442149 (the simpler tab-merge approach that this redesign replaces).
definitionOfDone: RunsPage lazy import removed from App.tsx
Runs nav item removed from AppShell sidebar
No dead references to standalone /runs in codebase
